create.name: Sri Ramana Maharshi Heritage
create.bio:
Sri Ramana Maharshi Heritage is a US non-profit, registered in 2022 and based in Fremont, California, that serves people drawn to the life and teaching of Sri Ramana Maharshi, the sage of Arunachala whose central practice was self-enquiry, the question 'Who am I?'. It works closely with Sri Ramanasramam in Tiruvannamalai, whose president has visited its gatherings, and it brings together several satsang groups across North America under one roof.

In the San Francisco Bay Area a weekly Saturday evening satsang, held in person and online, moves through chanting of Ramana's own compositions in Tamil and Sanskrit, a talk on his teaching, close study of a verse, reading from the classic records of his conversations, and silent meditation. Groups in the Washington DC area and Detroit follow a similar pattern, and the affiliated Sri Ramana Maharshi Center of Sonoma in Sebastopol keeps a satsang hall open for quiet sitting, with rooms for retreats. The Heritage also runs a monthly online satsang and a summer camp for young people, marks Ramana's birth, passing and arrival at Arunachala each year, and posts its talks, notably a long series of discourses on Atma Bodha, on YouTube and as a podcast.

courses.title: San Francisco Bay Area weekly satsang
courses.description: Every Saturday from 5 to 7 pm Pacific time, in person and on Zoom: chanting of Ramana's compositions, a talk on his teaching, study of one verse, readings from the records of his conversations, and twenty minutes of silent sitting. All are welcome.

courses.title: Sri Ramana Maharshi Center of Sonoma
courses.description: A satsang hall in Sebastopol, about fifty miles north of San Francisco, open for quiet meditation or study by door code, with a lending library, local and online satsangs, bhajan and film nights, and rooms for up to twelve people on overnight retreats.

courses.title: Washington DC area satsang
courses.description: Meetings on the first and third Saturdays of each month at 5.30 pm with readings from Ramana's talks and letters, chanting of his Tamil and Sanskrit works, devotional singing and meditation.

courses.title: Monthly virtual Youth Satsang
courses.description: A monthly Zoom meeting on the second Sunday for people aged 14 to 35 in North America, with reading, discussion of self-enquiry, chanting, individual singing and a guided meditation.

free_resources.title: Who am I?
free_resources.description: The Heritage's core-teaching page presents Ramana's short early text Who am I?, the basic instruction in self-enquiry, with a note on its history from A. W. Chadwick's memoir.
